about: Overnight release quiet window (Arman ruling 2026-10-15; same knob as aidream). While Arman is not active, the train releases at most once (release_at): a release inside the window is held until the 03:00 slot (the code itself still commits and pushes; Vercel builds only release commits). scripts/quiet_window.py reads this. release.sh --force-release (or MATRX_RELEASE_FORCE=1) always runs. OFF since 2026-10-18 00:15 PT: Arman asked for releases every hour tonight; turn back on (enabled=true) only on his word.
